steps.title: Prepare Taxol stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve Taxol in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) to make a 1 mM stock solution.

steps.title: Make sucrose cushion
steps.instruction: Dissolve 3 g sucrose in BRB80 containing 20 µM Taxol, bring the volume to 10 mL, and rotate the solution at 35 °C overnight.

steps.title: Prepare assay buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 180 µL of 0.5 M HEPES (adjust pH to 7.4 with KOH), 200 µL of 50 % glycerol, 50 µL of 1 M potassium acetate, 50 µL of 10 % Pluronic F‑127, 20 µL of 100 mM Mg(CH₃COO)₂, 20 µL of 50 mM EGTA, 20 µL of 10 mg mL⁻¹ κ‑casein, 20 µL of 50 mg mL⁻¹ BSA, 20 µL of 5 mg mL⁻¹ biotin‑BSA, and 1 µL of 1 mM Taxol; mix gently.

steps.title: Prepare Trolox solution
steps.instruction: Mix 430 µL methanol with 345 µL 1 M NaOH, dissolve 100 mg Trolox in the mixture, bring the volume to 4 mL with ddH₂O, rotate at 25 °C overnight, then pass the solution through a 0.22 µm filter.

steps.title: Make VALAP mounting medium
steps.instruction: Melt together 50 g Vaseline, 50 g lanolin, and 50 g paraffin to obtain VALAP.

steps.title: Label tubulin with biotin or dye
steps.instruction: Perform the labeling workflow as follows:

substeps.instruction: Dilute purified tubulin (7–10 mg mL⁻¹) to 7 mL of 3 mg mL⁻¹ with BRB80 on ice.
Add 35 µL of 1 M MgCl₂, 100 µL of 100 mM GTP, and 3.5 mL glycerol; mix gently and incubate at 37 °C for 60 min in a water bath.
Layer 1.75 mL of this mixture onto 1.4 mL high‑pH cushion in six 3.5 mL thick‑wall polycarbonate tubes; centrifuge at 80,000 × g for 35 min at 35 °C (TLA100.3 rotor).
Aspirate the supernatant slowly, then wash the cushion interface twice with 1 mL warm (37 °C) labeling buffer.
Resuspend each pellet sequentially in 500 µL warm (37 °C) labeling buffer, combining all six pellets into a total of 500 µL.
Add 1 mg of AFDye 647 NHS or Biotin‑PEG2‑NHS (dissolved in DMSO) to the suspension, vortex briefly, and incubate at 37 °C for 10 min, vortexing lightly every 2 min.
Add 530 µL warm quench buffer, vortex lightly, and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min to stop the reaction.
Layer 1 mL of the quenched mixture onto 1.5 mL low‑pH cushion in a 3.5 mL tube; centrifuge at 80,000 × g for 20 min at 35 °C.
Aspirate the supernatant, wash the cushion interface twice with warm (37 °C) BRB80, then resuspend the pellet in 500 µL cold (4 °C) BRB80 on ice.
Transfer to a 1 mL tube and centrifuge at 80,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C (TLA120.2 rotor).
Collect the supernatant, add on ice 130 µL 5× BRB80, 2 µL 1 M MgCl₂, and 5 µL 100 mM GTP; add 330 µL glycerol, mix gently, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.
Layer 1 mL of this polymerization mix onto 1.5 mL low‑pH cushion; centrifuge at 80,000 × g for 35 min at 35 °C.
Aspirate the supernatant, wash the cushion interface twice with warm (37 °C) BRB80, then wash the pellet interface twice with the same buffer.
Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL cold (4 °C) BRB80, incubate on ice for 20 min, and centrifuge at 80,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Measure labeled tubulin concentration by SDS‑PAGE, aliquot supernatant in 3 µL portions, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

Prepare 25 µL elongation mix containing 20 µL unlabeled tubulin (3 mg mL⁻¹), 2 µL biotin‑labeled tubulin (3 mg mL⁻¹), 2 µL fluorescently labeled tubulin (3 mg mL⁻¹), and 1 µL 100 mM GTP; the labeled tubulin fractions should be ~1/10–1/40 of the unlabeled tubulin.
Incubate the mix at 37 °C for ≥20 min (≈10–20 µm microtubules) or up to 45 min for longer filaments.
Add 25 µL of 40 µM Taxol, incubate at 37 °C for ≥15 min.
Layer the reaction on 150 µL sucrose cushion in a 0.2 mL thick‑wall polycarbonate tube; centrifuge at 50,000 × g for 10 min at 35 °C.
Aspirate the supernatant, wash the cushion interface twice with warm (37 °C) BRB80, then resuspend the pellet in 50 µL BRB80 containing 20 µM Taxol.
Store the polymerized microtubules at room temperature protected from light.
Acid‑wash coverslips in HCl for 24 h, then rinse thoroughly with ddH₂O.
Fill a container with ddH₂O and sonicate in a 42 kHz water bath three times for 30 min each.
Sequentially fill the container with 50 %, 70 %, and 95 % ethanol, sonicate 30 min at each concentration (42 kHz).
Finally fill with 95 % ethanol and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Assemble flow chamber
steps.instruction: Burn both sides of each cleaned coverslip with a gas burner to volatilize residual ethanol, then attach the coverslip to a microscope slide using two pieces of double‑sided tape at the top and bottom, creating an open channel (~3 mm wide).

steps.title: Functionalize chamber surface
steps.instruction: Introduce surface‑coating reagents in the assembled chamber:

substeps.instruction: Flow 10 µL of 0.5 mg mL⁻¹ PLL‑PEG‑biotin into the channel, incubate 5 min.
Flow 10 µL of 0.5 mg mL⁻¹ streptavidin, incubate 2 min.
Wash unbound streptavidin with two aliquots of 20 µL BRB80.

steps.title: Introduce labeled microtubules
steps.instruction: Flow 10 µL of labeled microtubules diluted 1:50 in BRB80 containing 20 µM Taxol into the chamber, let sit >5 min, then wash unbound microtubules with two 20 µL aliquots of assay buffer.

steps.title: Prepare observation mix
steps.instruction: Combine the following to make 50 µL observation mix:

substeps.instruction: 29 µL assay buffer
16 µL ddH₂O
1 µL purified kinesin (10 pM–10 nM, depending on motor)
1 µL 100 mM ATP
1 µL 100 mM protocatechuic acid (PCA)
1 µL 2.5 mM protocatechuate‑3,4‑dioxygenase (PCD)
1 µL 100 mM Trolox

steps.title: Run TIRF imaging
steps.instruction: Flow 10 µL of the observation mix into the chamber, then observe single‑molecule kinesin motility on a TIRF microscope at 24 ± 1 °C using 488 nm, 561 nm, and 647 nm lasers (≈15 mW each; laser powers 5–9 % as described). Record videos at 10 frames s⁻¹.
